user.title: Redirect URI
user.description:
Verify the **Redirect URI** below matches what you configured in the Xthings / ULTRALOQ app under **Settings > OpenAPI**.

Auto-detected: `{default_redirect_uri}`

Change it only if the auto-detected value is incorrect.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Integration
reauth_confirm.description: The Xthings (U-tec) integration needs to re-authenticate your account.

abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.

application_credentials.description:
To obtain credentials, open the Xthings / ULTRALOQ app, go to **Settings > OpenAPI**, and activate it. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** shown there.

Set the **Redirect URI** in the app to your Home Assistant external URL followed by `/auth/external/callback`. The correct value will be shown during setup.

init.title: Xthings Options
init.description:
Enable push notifications for near-instant state updates. Nabu Casa Cloud status: **{cloud_status}**.

If you have Nabu Casa, leave the URL blank to use a cloudhook automatically. Otherwise, enter your externally reachable Home Assistant URL (e.g. `{example_url}`).
